from scipy.spatial.transform import Rotation

def arm_transform(q, spec):
    T = np.eye(4)
    for axis, point, angle in zip(spec['arm']['axis'], spec['arm']['position_m'], q):
        axis, point = np.asarray(axis), np.asarray(point)
        J = np.eye(4)
        J[:3,:3] = Rotation.from_rotvec(axis*angle).as_matrix()
        J[:3,3] = point-J[:3,:3]@point
        T = T@J
    return T

def pose_points(q,spec):
    T=arm_transform(q,spec)
    cam=spec['cameras']['robot_wrist']['pose']
    trans=lambda p: (T@np.r_[p,1])[:3]
    rot=lambda v: T[:3,:3]@v
    return {'ee':trans(spec['arm']['end_effector']['position_m']),
            'cam':trans(cam['position_m']),
            'forward':rot(cam['forward']), 'up':rot(cam['up']), 'right':rot(cam['right'])}

from scipy.optimize import least_squares

def ik_camera(target_pos,target_forward,q0,spec,position_weight=1,orientation_weight=.4):
    target_pos=np.asarray(target_pos); target_forward=np.asarray(target_forward)

def ik_ee(target_pos,q0,spec,target_forward=None,orientation_weight=.4):
    target_pos=np.asarray(target_pos)
    def residual(q):
        p=pose_points(q,spec)
        r=[*(p['ee']-target_pos)]
        if target_forward is not None:r.extend(orientation_weight*(p['forward']-target_forward))
        r.extend(.005*(q-q0))
